name: Lubberkin
description: A lubberkin is a peaceful guardian spirit created when a botchling is given a name through the elven Aymm Rhoin ritual and buried beneath its family's threshold.
story: A curse answered with dignity can become a guide instead of a monster.
lore: It retains the small, unsettling shape of a botchling, but is surrounded by a pale spectral glow and shows no hunger for the living. Bound to the hearth it never knew, a lubberkin watches over its family and can lead those it trusts along hidden trails.

encounter.title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt and expansions
encounter.note: Game reference cross-check; the trail is associated with Crow's Perch, Velen.
